H3.policy: Original ending_lm v2 must be recovered and exactly specified; no replacement, no omission, no zero-filled result, no reduced-H run.

controls: Identity/no-op G1→G2p0→G3p0 and G4 boundary representations.
Unit-label permutation and family-label permutation negatives; chance classification is expected under exchangeable/null labels.
Duplicate/near-duplicate source works stay in one partition; repeated seed/text leakage audit.
Real abbreviated-Latin reserve never fits abbreviation rates or rule vocabulary; all unseen-sign abstentions retained.
Source genre/date/orthography contrasts reported separately; no Italian literary or Gascon legal result relabelled as a medical-genre test.
Known text controls also pass representation/unknown-unit gates before attempting survival scoring.

current_state.source_control: SOURCE-CONTROL-RESULTS.json is ingestion/representation only; real G2 survival NOT_RUN.

fitting.budget: Maximum250000 simulator calls per family/cell/trial, including all SMC stages/ESS escalation; checkpoint all attempts. Set wall-time caps from a separate S_fit-only runtime benchmark before release. Budget exhaustion or mapping failure must not be relabelled cannot mimic basics. A completed predeclared prior-predictive search may report CANNOT_MIMIC_BASICS only with its fit-distance evidence and explicitly bounded search scope, not proof about all possible parameters.
fitting.distance: Euclidean on registered S_fit blocks, standardized using each pseudo-target whole-page bootstrap SD; zero-SD mismatch remains infinity.
fitting.method: ABC-SMC on S_fit only for every candidate family, including the true family
fitting.note: This is an expensive full protocol, not a job launched by this design. Three2000-particle generations alone imply at least216million accepted particles before proposal rejections.
fitting.particle_escalation: Allowed2000->4000->8000 only to meet final ESS, with unchanged priors/tolerances; record all stages and failures.
fitting.tolerance_calibration: Using S_fit only before claim freeze: final epsilon from the95th percentile of predeclared whole-page bootstrap standardized distances; fixed SMC schedule4×,2×,1× epsilon. Preserve full calibration draw table; do not choose on H1–H8 or classification performance.

gates.boundaries: No correct-label selection requirement where families overlap. Shared mechanisms should co-survive. Report empirical equivalence sets and false exclusion of each shared representation.
gates.correct_family_survival: At least80/100 per true-family×reading-cell, with95% binomial intervals reported. This keeps the stated80% empirical gate; uncertainty is not hidden.
gates.failure_terminal: Any required survival/discrimination/control gate fails => report PIPELINE_CANNOT_DISCRIMINATE for that scope, do not interpret manuscript model probabilities or elimination. No threshold repair in this cut.
gates.incomplete: Every scheduled record must have a terminal auditable status. Mapping/unknown/source-size support or computation failures are not negative manuscript evidence. Unsupported recovery cells cannot qualify corresponding manuscript claims.
gates.interior_discrimination: In at least64/80 interior trials, true family survives and at least3 of5 wrong families are rejected. Report basic-fit rejection separately from H-specific elimination.
gates.pairwise: Every family pair gets its own false-exclusion and survival/co-survival table. Do not infer that two families are distinguishable merely because the global majority gate passes.
gates.parameter_recovery: For every preregistered identifiable numeric parameter: true value inside90% interval in>=80% of eligible interior trials; median absolute posterior-median error<=.20 prior-range; median interval width<=.60 prior-range. Seeds, offsets and label-permuted keys are nuisance, not identifiable targets. Categorical identifiable parameters: true category posterior mass>=.8 in>=80% eligible interior trials. Declare every exemption before scoring; retain failures.

geometry.H_F: Separate fits and confusion matrices. H/F are alternative coverage/templates, not independent manuscript replications. Both reading-specific gates must pass for a Currier×scribe headline; do not multiply p-values or pretend separately generated pseudo-texts are paired transcriptions.
geometry.layout: One declared conditioning contract for all families before freeze; preserve published G5 native character-count generation. Match target sample size by stopping/censoring at declared boundaries, never forcing outcomes. Do not include an exactly conditioned line statistic again as independent evidence.
geometry.primary: Existing ten Currier×Davis-scribe×reading cells; exact retained page/line/unknown-mask geometry; reserved zodiac never loaded.
geometry.real_known_text: Additional primary real abbreviated-Latin control at its own five-page native size, not padded/repeated to match larger manuscript cells.15th-century scholastic and earlier medical sources are separate sensitivity strata.
geometry.recovery_units: 100 independent pseudo-manuscripts per true family per reading-cell; six families ×ten cells =6000 datasets.
geometry.source_length: No cyclic source wrapping for primary claim/recovery. Source segments stay contiguous within a work, with every page/word boundary and unknown retained. Insufficient disjoint source material is UNSUPPORTED_AT_SIZE, not a family rejection.

predictive.H2: Availability-strengthening targets must be recomputed on approved log-OR scale; legacy RD ratios are not numeric log-OR targets.
predictive.elimination: At least two failed H-families among H1,H2,H3,H6. Missing/unsupported makes overall elimination NOT_ESTIMABLE if it could change the decision; cannot count as passing. H4/H5/H7/H8 diagnostics do not add votes.
predictive.intervals: Report every component percentile and interval as descriptive alongside the one-family flag. One H3 context subcomponent is not interchangeable with the whole H3 test. An infinite calibrated vector threshold or inadequate predictive ESS is NOT_ESTIMABLE, not an automatic pass.
predictive.scalar_rule: Weighted central95% posterior predictive interval, endpoints inclusive; outside gives one failed H-family.
predictive.vector_rule: H3/H6 vector components jointly count as at most one failed H-family. Predeclare component names. Deterministically split predictive draws into location/scale and calibration halves. Weighted median and MAD from first half; max absolute standardized component departure calibrated at weighted95th percentile on second half gives a simultaneous envelope. Zero spread: exact equality contributes0, otherwise infinity. Unsupported components invalidate that H-family; never drop components post hoc.
predictive.weighting: Use ABC importance weights; do not treat weighted accepted particles as equally likely.

pseudo_truth.labels: Truth parameters/source IDs remain in sealed receipt, never predictor features or fitting inputs. Arbitrary code-unit names, mapping IDs, file names, seeds and family names must not enter summary vectors.
pseudo_truth.mapping: Rebuild the candidate mapping and bootstrap standardization against each pseudo-target exactly as for the manuscript. Never provide the true mapping/key to the inference code. Treat deterministic tie/label conventions as nuisance; relabeling negative controls must prevent artificial family recognition.
nested_cases: G2 abbreviation probability0 reduces to G1 source representation.
G3 symbol probability0 reduces to G2.
G4 no nulls/no position variants overlaps G1 up to codebook representation.
pseudo_truth.parameters: Draw from frozen priors with stratified quantiles; interior numeric probabilities in[.1,.9] of their permitted range, categorical factors balanced; all source/codebook nuisance draws recorded. Boundary20 exercise literal shared submodels, not expected identifications.

random_forest.probability: Pudlo-style selected-model probability from out-of-bag allocation-error regression; forest vote fractions are descriptive. Do not invent probabilities for all families.
random_forest.reference_table: At least5000 independent prior-predictive records per family per supported geometry, disjoint truth/test seeds and source partitions. Group duplicate latent texts/source blocks in folds. No held-statistic reference table may be generated before claim freeze.
random_forest.role: Descriptive only after all required discrimination gates pass; not used to change elimination thresholds.

release_requirements: All H1–H8 adapters and component names defined and hashed, including original H3.
Complete claim FREEZE.json hashes code, sources, priors, mapping, layout, budgets, target/statistic adapters and this protocol.
Source-support, unknown-unit, layout and negative-control policies settled before any held scores.
scope: Qualify this finite implementation/prior/source set at supported sizes; no mechanism-wide historical exclusion.
uncertainty: Binomial intervals quantify seed/draw variation conditional on the fixed corpus/geometry; they are not independent-language or independent-manuscript population intervals.
